description: This file contains selector functions for managing roles, permissions, and group memberships within the Mattermost Redux state, including functions to check permissions at team, group, and channel levels.

methods.name: getMySystemPermissions
methods.description: Returns the set of system permissions for the current user.

methods.name: getMySystemRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of system roles for the current user.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Returns a record of all roles.

methods.name: haveISystemPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific system permission.

methods.name: getGroupMemberships
methods.description: Returns a record of group memberships for the current user.

methods.name: getMyGroupRoles
methods.description: Returns roles assigned to the user within groups.

methods.name: getGroupListPermissions
methods.description: Returns permissions for all mentionable and not deleted groups.

methods.name: getMyTeamRoles
methods.description: Returns roles assigned to the user within teams.

methods.name: getMyChannelRoles
methods.description: Returns roles assigned to the user within channels.

methods.name: getRolesById
methods.description: Returns roles indexed by role ID.

methods.name: haveITeamPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission in a team.

methods.name: haveIGroupPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission in a group.

methods.name: haveIChannelPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission in a channel.

methods.name: haveICurrentTeamPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission in the current team.

methods.name: haveICurrentChannelPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission in the current channel.
